title: Reading starlight
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Atoms and ions absorb or emit light at characteristic wavelengths. Comparing the pattern of lines with laboratory spectra helps identify chemical elements.

misconception: A learner may choose: Every element produces the same line pattern
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: How can a spectrum help identify an element in a star?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: How can a spectrum help identify an element in a star? Its pattern of spectral lines acts as a fingerprint. Atoms and ions absorb or emit light at characteristic wavelengths. Comparing the pattern of lines with laboratory spectra helps identify chemical elements.
Visual caption: Lines identify elements. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
